model: pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 smart-turn-v3.2-cpu.onnx (8.7 MB, BSD-2-Clause), onnxruntime 1.31 CPU
data: 120 synthetic utterances: macOS TTS voices (zh-CN, en-US), 60 finished sentences and 60 sentences cut where a speaker would continue, 0.4 s trailing silence; NOT real human speech

textHeuristic.caveat: the unfinished prefixes were written by the same author as the heuristic and end in connectors it knows (然后, 但是, to, and…): optimistic

conclusion: Inconclusive and not enough to integrate: on synthetic speech the audio model separates finished from unfinished only weakly (zh barely better than chance). Decide with real recordings from the target users; keep the text endpointer until then.
